I replied to Pree in a thread under her message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm the 23 May deadline for Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form, and I couldn't rule it out either.

- **What I checked:** Only what Pree herself can see. There's no Thornbury Cloth Co. folder in the shared files, and Thornbury isn't mentioned in #central-team or the Central team's summary files.
- **Which year:** Today is 14 Oct 2026, so "23 May" has either already passed this year or means May 2027. I suggested she ask the account owner or the customer contact which they meant, and get the date in writing before anyone plans around it.
- **For later:** I saved a note in this channel recording it as unconfirmed, overheard on a call, so it won't be treated as a real deadline in later conversations here.
